48.original: Thank goodness you are here. I need your help.

49.original: One of the stone guardians in the ruins, it...it attacked our sisters.

50.original: I would go and help them, but I fear I cannot do it alone. Please, I beg you─come with me to the Morning Stars.

51.original: You came! Thank the gods. There is yet one more to the north, closer to the Great Pyramid.

52.original: I will see to this one here. Go and save our sister. When you have her, take her back to Fanow.

54.original: I believe I am well enough to walk on my own. Let us hurry back, before another sentinel arrives.

55.original: You are returned. Good. All of our hunters are accounted for.

56.original: The sentinels have helped guard these ruins for centuries. It is unsettling to know they may now turn on us at any given moment.

57.original: Such a thing was inconceivable before the Flood, but as the Light takes its toll they grow increasingly erratic.

58.original: Indeed, it has made our duty to these ruins all the more difficult, but we will not be dissuaded from doing what must be done.

59.original: It is not much, but I would like you to have this. For helping save my sisters. I pray we can count on your aid should we have need of it again.
